scope: TWL RTC counter and bounded alarm IRQ
PCF8574 GPIO provider and as-is reads

safety.gpio: Probe and ASIS flags=0 reads perform no latch writes. Required retain-state-shutdown prevents all-high shutdown write. No direction, bias, drive, reset or output consumers.
safety.rtc: HCTOSYS, SYSTOHC and RTC NVMEM disabled. Calendar time is not set. One five-second alarm test backs up and restores cached alarm plus exact alarm/IRQ bytes.
safety.clocks: Unmodified CLK_TWL probe registers clk32kg/clk32kaudio. CLK_IGNORE_UNUSED, no consumers/assigned clocks and no prepare/enable/rate test. Compare PMIC clock registers and zero CCF use counts.
safety.power: No regulator, charger, ADC, power-off or audio driver enabled. Retain ram95 voltage and GPIO policy.
safety.recovery: Existing one-shot U-Boot, exact factory p8 restoration, unchanged watchdog and read-only eMMC

checks: raw port equals native GPIO-v2 as-is read
clock API registrations/rates and zero consumers
deferred: audio playback and physical endpoint routing
